facts.fact: Bénin Web TV says the BCEAO instruction of 23 January 2024 on payment services distinguishes payment institutions from banks, microfinance institutions and e-money institutions and defines them as payment service providers; it binds UMOA members including Togo.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: Bénin Web TV, citing the BCEAO list published 8 October 2026, says Togo had three licensed payment institutions at 31 August 2026 under the 2024 instruction.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA
